project_cn: Verus Ethereum Bridge（7 月重复根覆盖）
vulnerability_cn: 跨链重复键解析差异与导入金额约束不足
vulnerability_en: Duplicate-key interpretation mismatch and insufficient import-value constraints
detail_cn: 同一组带签名的公证字节，在 Verus 的 map.insert 中保留首个 systemID 根，在 Ethereum 反序列化循环中由后续同 ID 根覆盖。受污染的可信根让伪造导入证明通过，SubmitImports 随后委托 TokenManager 释放真实 ETH 和代币。已归档两笔历史公证调用及主攻击完整跟踪，并对应公开原始模块源码；源链各笔公证字节未独立从 Verus RPC 重读，源码和历史状态等价性未全面核实，未重放。源表约 760 万美元与其他披露估值不统一，金额留空，逐币数量另记。
detail_en: The same signed notarization bytes preserve the first systemID root through Verus map.insert, but later entries overwrite the root in Ethereum's deserialization loop. The poisoned trusted root lets a fabricated import proof pass, after which SubmitImports delegates real ETH/token payouts to TokenManager. Two historical notarization calls and the focal attack's complete traces are archived and tied to public original module sources. Source-chain notarization bytes were not independently re-read from Verus RPC; full source/historical-state equivalence and replay remain unverified. Aggregate USD loss is blank because the sheet's approximate USD 7.6M and other disclosure valuations differ; per-asset quantities are recorded separately.
loss_scope: Aggregate USD estimates differ: sheet 7.6M, CertiK 7.44M, other contemporaneous reports 7.54M; no independent historical valuation was reconstructed.
